attempted_claim: There exists an ageometric, atoroidal, fully irreducible phi in Out(F_4), represented by an explicit positive word in family F on the 4-rose, whose train-track transition matrix M is Perron-Frobenius irreducible with stretch factor lambda = lambda(M) (logged via characteristic polynomial plus enclosure), whose ideal Whitehead graph is a specified connected 7-vertex graph, and which carries no periodic Nielsen paths; this phi is a new ageometric-versus-geometric separation (gap) witness for the rank-4 stratum.
claim_type: stretch-factor spectral gap with ageometric-versus-geometric separation witness for fully irreducible automorphisms
decisive_failure: value: The strongest self-contained headline is one short positive word phi=(bad,cd,ad,db) with its transition matrix, PF eigenvalue enclosure lambda approx 2.1177, gate/turn fragment, and order-<=12 abelian screen — while the draft explicitly disclaims every property that would give the object mathematical distinction: full irreducibility is NOT proved (only primitive-matrix plus connected-closure input is supplied), PNP-free/ageometric status is NOT established (only 'no taken illegal turn,' i.e. no period-1 iNP on a taken turn), the 7-vertex ideal Whitehead graph is NOT computed, atoroidality is NOT proved (only the abelian eigenvalue screen), and minimality in any stratum is NOT claimed. What remains is therefore an arbitrary member of the bounded short-word family (one of thousands of equivalent routine positive words, selected with no proved distinguishing feature) carrying an unexplained number: lambda approx 2.1177 is exactly enclosed but has no proved interpretation — it is not shown minimal, not shown to separate geometric from ageometric strata, and not shown to decide any open question. The computations themselves (M^3>0, charpoly, sign-change plus Collatz-Wielandt enclosure, gate tabulation, polynomial gcds) are standard textbook exercises applied to routine parameters. Under the governing standard this is the conjunction the instructions direct auditors to reject: a mere parameter substitution on a routine example yielding an arbitrary object with an unexplained number, where certification alone (VERIFY_OK) does not rescue value. The three conditions of the exact-invariant clause are not jointly met: although the rank-4 train-track/stretch-factor theme was motivated before computation and the digits were not previously known, no future researcher could reasonably need THIS precise fact as stated, because without iwip/PNP/atoroidal/minimal status the word cannot serve as a stratum witness, extremal input, or classification entry. The draft's honesty about its limitations is commendable but does not create value. The defect is intrinsic (arbitrary scope, missing substantive result), not a presentation gap: the only additions that could confer value — proving full irreducibility, running the complete Pfaff PNP test with ideal Whitehead graph, proving atoroidality, or establishing stratum minimality — are the original hard research program itself, not a bounded topic-preserving addition. Value FAILS.

Success is one certified ageometric (PNP-free), atoroidal, fully irreducible witness with connected 7-vertex ideal Whitehead graph and logged (word, M, lambda).
